run_pulsar_sphere_renderer: run the pulsar sphere renderer to render 10 random spheres and save the output image
create_pointclouds_with_pytorch3d: create a Pointclouds object with random vertex positions and color features on GPU
build_perspective_cameras: build PerspectiveCameras with a custom focal length, rotation matrix, and translation vector
render_points_with_pulsar: render points using PulsarPointsRenderer with gamma blending, znear, zfar, and background color
save_rendered_image: save the rendered PyTorch3D image tensor to a PNG file using imageio
